The comment describes behaviour the code does not produce.
findings.suggested_investigation: Confirm DrawSeam is false in the shipped build (ShieldBar.cpp:151) and that line 302 is the only use of dw/SeamTint. Then check whether the comment at 283-284 should say the seam is disabled (DrawSeam=false) or whether DrawSeam should be true. Compare with the user note at line 151 before changing either.
findings.why_it_matters: A reader trusting the comment will expect a groove between the shield and health bars that never renders, and may tune or debug the wrong thing (e.g. the seam width `dw` at line 285 is computed but only used in the disabled branch). The comment and the user decision recorded at line 151 disagree.
